sentences.en: In clear weather one can see Mount Fuji from here.
sentences.zh: 天气晴朗时，这里可以看到富士山。

sentences.en: The pile of garbage is as big as Mount Everest.
sentences.zh: 这堆垃圾有珠穆朗玛峰那么大。

sentences.en: I want to climb to the peak of Mount Kitadake.
sentences.zh: 我想爬到北天山的山顶。
